case_number: 2024 INSC 579; CIVIL APPEAL No.7930 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.31314 of 2012)
summary: Delimitation challenge; constitutional bar under Article 329(a); scope of judicial review; mala fide/arbitrariness exception; Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam precedent; Meghraj Kothari interpreted; partial allowance of appeal; impugned bar set aside; no interference with 2006 delimitation.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; para 3 of High Court judgment set aside; no interference with 2006 delimitation order.
